observations: Photo 0: Blue PS4 Slim console wrapped in clear plastic film, 'Days of Play' button-symbol design visible, PlayStation logo visible on corner.
Photo 1: Same console next to a blue/grey camouflage DualShock 4 controller, plastic wrap still on console body.
Photo 2: Close-up of console corner with PlayStation logo and one camo controller, console still wrapped in film.
Only one controller is visible across all three photos despite seller claiming 'original pads' (plural).
No power cable, HDMI cable, box, receipt, or game discs are shown in any photo.
No photo shows the console powered on or a screen/output to confirm it functions.
Plastic wrap on the shell could be a resale/marketing wrap rather than factory seal, and does not prove the unit is unused.

identity.kind: PS4 Slim console (Days of Play limited edition style) with one DualShock 4 controller
read_from: photo 0 PlayStation logo and button-symbol design

claims.claim: Comes with 10 latest games including FIFA and PES 2027
claims.evidence: No game discs or digital library shown in any photo; 'PES 2027' is not a known released title, making the claim internally inconsistent.

claims.evidence: Cannot inspect internals or screws from photos.

No receipt image provided in the three photos.

risks.proof: A clip/photo of the console powered on, showing the home screen or system settings
risks.if_unproven: priced as not confirmed working, i.e. worst case as non-functional

risks.risk: Only one controller present, not the 'original pads' plural implied
risks.proof: A photo showing a second original controller alongside the console

risks.risk: No games actually included or discs may be pirated/corrupted
risks.proof: Photo of the game case/discs or screenshot of installed game library on the console menu
risks.if_unproven: priced as console-only, no games included

risks.risk: No proof of purchase/receipt, affecting authenticity and warranty claims
risks.proof: Clear photo of the UK receipt with matching serial number
risks.if_unproven: priced as no proof of origin

risks.proof: Photo with wrap removed showing actual shell condition, scratches, and vents
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming visible cosmetic wear is hidden, i.e. worst case cosmetic condition

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and running a game or the home menu
Photo of all included accessories (both controllers, cables, box) laid out together
Clear photo of the UK receipt with serial number matching the console's rear label
Photo of the actual game discs or case inserts for the '10 latest games' claimed
Photo of the console with plastic wrap removed to see true shell condition
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a Sony PS4 Slim (Days of Play style) with one controller, but none of the seller's functional or bundle claims are verifiable from photos, and the 'PES 2027' detail is inconsistent, so it must be priced at worst case as an unconfirmed-working single-controller console with no verified games or receipt.
